per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across all records
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Name must not be null
Name must use Title Case format (flag all lowercase or all uppercase words except known particles)
Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
Name must match the corresponding Full_Name value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must conform to Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
ID_No must match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Race must not be null
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must not be null
Gender must be either Male or Female
Age must not be null
Age must be parseable as an integer
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
Age must not be negative
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number: 8 digits, optionally prefixed with 65 or +65 (total 10 digits with country code)
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Country must not be null
Country must be 'Singapore' (canonical form)
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must not be in all uppercase
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
